# Center for Enriched Living (CEL)

> > Center for Enriched Living empowers individuals with developmental and intellectual disabilities through employment programs, social recreation, summer camps, and community partnerships in the Chicago area.

CEL, led by CEO Herbert K. Washington, Jr., provides comprehensive services including supported employment, volunteer opportunities, and transformational programs that foster independence and community integration. The organization relies on donations, fundraising events like Chefs' Night, and employer partnerships to sustain its mission.

## Key Topics

- developmental disabilities
- intellectual disabilities
- supported employment
- disability services

## Programs & Services

- [For Job Seekers](https://www.experiencecel.org/program/for-job-seekers): Employment support program for job seekers with developmental disabilities
- [For Employers](https://www.experiencecel.org/program/employ-cel-members): Employer partnerships for hiring CEL members through Employment Opportunities Program
- [Summer Camp](https://www.experiencecel.org/program/summer-camp): Summer camp program for teens/young adults with developmental disabilities

## Ways to Support CEL

- [Donate Today](https://www.experiencecel.org/ways-to-give/one-time-gifts): One-time donation page supporting CEL programs for developmental disabilities
- [Volunteer](https://www.experiencecel.org/get-involved/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities to engage with members with developmental disabilities
- [Transformational Gifts](https://www.experiencecel.org/ways-to-give/transformational-gifts): Major donor transformational gifts supporting CEL independence programs
- [Tax-Smart Giving](https://www.experiencecel.org/ways-to-give/gifts-of-stock): Tax-smart donation options including stock gifts and IRA disbursements to CEL
- [Chefs' Night Tasting Partners](https://www.experiencecel.org/chefs-night-tasting-partners): Chefs' Night fundraiser tasting partner and vendor participation information

## Careers & Opportunities

- [Work at CEL](https://www.experiencecel.org/careers): Employment opportunities at CEL including LCSW and camp instructor positions
- [Internship Application Confirmation](https://www.experiencecel.org/internapply): Internship application confirmation page for CEL student opportunities

- [Perspectives & Press](https://www.experiencecel.org/about-us/perspectives-press): CEL press updates, newsletters, perspectives, and blog posts hub
- [Herbert K. Washington, Jr. Named CEO](https://www.experiencecel.org/center-for-enriched-living-selects-herbert-k-washington-jr-as-chief-executive-officer): Press release announcing Herbert K. Washington, Jr. as new CEL CEO
- [CEL Partners with First Responders](https://www.experiencecel.org/cel-partners-with-first-responders-for-developmental-disability-training): CEL trains first responders on safely interacting with people with disabilities
- [Revolution Brewing Behind-the-Scenes Tour](https://www.experiencecel.org/cel-members-explore-revolution-brewery-a-behind-the-scenes-tour): Social Recreation members' behind-the-scenes tour at Revolution Brewing
- [From Staff to Volunteer, Four Decades Later](https://www.experiencecel.org/from-staff-to-volunteer-four-decades-later): Volunteer story about Marilyn's journey from CEL staff to volunteer since 1988
